guards: Do not manufacture actions to fill categories.
Treat free-market watch and clause watch as separate decision domains.
Prioritize executable actions over passive monitoring when evidence is comparable.
Keep at most one passive clause watch unless there is a real clause execution.
Allow capital-appreciation trades, but cap pure speculation below strong sporting/hybrid targets.
Do not recommend selling into strong positive VM momentum unless sporting risk is extreme.
Clause execution must come from the strict clause radar opportunity state.
Lineup changes need a material projected gain or meaningful starting-risk signal.
